Callout.Name: Pack of Wild Dogs
Callout.Message: Pack of dogs worrying sheep on two farms.
Callout.Advisory: Four or five animals, no owner identified.

Script.Line: They have had two of my lambs and my neighbour has lost three.
It is a pack of four at least. They are not frightened of anything.
I would bring a rifle if I were you. I would, honestly.

Lines.Approach: Four or five of them working two farms in a week. The farmers are taking it badly.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
